title: Bounded CPU plausibility screen with prevalence-adjusted estimates
query_selection: All development-test attack rows plus the first 1024 NormalTraffic rows ranked by SHA256(query_hash_tag|fingerprint). Order the combined query by the same hash and reuse it for all three seeds.
query_weights: Attack rows receive weight 1; NormalTraffic rows receive weight 29929/1024. The weights sum to 30787. Scores estimate this prescreen execution at original test prevalence; they are not actual full-E1 scores.
primary_gate: Require all three paired seeds. Report PRELIMINARY_PROMISING only if the mean weighted-estimated macro-F1 delta is at least 0.02 and both high-risk mean recall deltas are at least -0.05. Otherwise report PRELIMINARY_NEGATIVE. Missing pairs remain INCOMPLETE. Never report a full E1 pass.
baseline_policy: Reuse exact query indices, class order and fit supports from hash-verified completed E1 CPU Random Forest, XGBoost and LightGBM cells. Do not refit baselines. Select the GBDT family separately for each seed using only its original selected inner-CV macro-F1; ties choose XGBoost.
rescope_timing: Freeze after classical scores are known and before foundation-model classification outcomes. This is an explicit compute-budget rescope.
rescope_reason: AWS sign-in expired and GPU access remains unavailable. Full ten-seed foundation evaluation on CPU was estimated at about ten hours. This separate 1882-row, three-seed query provides a bounded plausibility test.
not_performed: Completion of the full registered E1 experiment
required_reporting: Unweighted query metrics and prevalence-adjusted estimated metrics for all five models
Per-stage precision, recall, F1, confusion matrices, ROC-AUC and average precision
Raw sampled benign false-positive counts and their weighted estimates
Full-test versus weighted-estimated macro-F1 for all three baselines
Checkpoint, data, support, query, weight, code and version provenance
TabPFN secondary outcomes regardless of the primary result
limitations: The same benign query sample is reused across three seeds. Repeated fitting seeds do not reduce uncertainty from benign sampling.
Each sampled benign false alarm represents 29929/1024 original normal rows. Zero sampled false positives does not establish zero full-test false positives.
Aggregated scores are nonlinear plug-in estimates, not unbiased F1 estimates.
Foundation prediction batch invariance is unverified. Changing query batch composition may change predictions.
Attack recall covers all 858 attack rows for this prescreen execution, including 15 InitialCompromise and 106 DataExfiltration examples.
No significance interval, temporal or incident generalization, novelty, or guaranteed positive outcome is claimed.
execution_policy: Freeze source and protocol before fitting. The prefit receipt binds exact queries, weights, supports, checkpoints and baselines. Resume only verified completed cells; preserve and reject incomplete nonempty cells.
cpu_thread_detail: Set PyTorch intra-operation threads to 4 and inter-operation threads to 2. Override TabICL n_jobs to 4 in this separate runner; the shared E1 backend remains unchanged.
